text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card (22.9% share, 4.3% expected, 5.3x, risk score 7.84, z 2.76, 23% of 99215s on low-complexity patients, 44 charts, 21 documented 99215s with 0 below billed, 3 of 31 data notes). Note signal rates (problems 20%, late 9%, data 7%, unsigned 0%) match the final hybrid_review for 44 notes. The summary is cautious and the leaning is inconclusive, which fits. But there are real problems. The unmatched '25%' comparison rate is not on the card, which shows an all-provider rate of 9.7% for 99215. The summary presents the 25% as the comparison-provider rate, which looks like a misread. The headline says 'random plus a targeted 99215 sample', but the tool outputs show only random samples, so that claim is unsupported. The cited example C0008899 is a 99214 below-billed claim, which is not a 99215 finding. The two low-complexity examples are the first rows on the list rather than the strongest. The rationale says the documentation 'does not support an upcoding finding', yet the next step asks for a targeted 99215 sample, which is somewhat contradictory. The summary does not mention that 99214 is the most common code (338 claims), nor the 10 high-complexity 99215 claims. It does flag the missing audit trail and deficiencies only partly (no mention of the missing signature or results). Overall it is mostly accurate but has a wrong comparator figure and an unsupported headline claim.","problems":["Comparison-provider rate of 25% is not on the card; the card's all-provider rate for 99215 is 9.7%, so this looks misread or fabricated","Headline claims a 'targeted 99215 sample' but the tool outputs show only random samples","Cited example C0008899 is a 99214 claim and does not bear on 99215 upcoding","Low-complexity examples appear to be arbitrary first rows, and the summary does not note that documented 99215 claims (e.g., C0008475, C0008883) were rated high MDM even though they are listed as low-complexity","Does not mention the deficiencies in the exchange (MISSING_RESULTS, MISSING_SIGNATURE) or that 44 of 45 charts were usable","Next step is somewhat contradictory: it says documentation does not support upcoding but then asks for more charts, with only a generic targeted request"]}
